description: React functional component 'ModelFilters' for filtering model groups based on user-selected criteria such as provider, mode, features, and search term. It manages local state for filters, computes filtered data, and communicates changes upward.

methods.name: getUniqueProviders
methods.description: Returns an array of unique provider names from the data set.

methods.name: getUniqueModes
methods.description: Returns an array of unique modes from the data set.

methods.name: getUniqueFeatures
methods.description: Returns an array of unique feature names (derived from 'supports_' keys) where the value is true.

methods.name: resetFilters
methods.description: Resets all filter states to their initial empty values.
